issue.title: bank config diagnostics lose locations: rules findings have line null and list -f json keeps only the first error
issue.description:
Fix both location losses in bank config diagnostics:

- Index sequence items in `bank_line_map` so `bank.rules.<N>` and `bank.rules.<N>.<field>`
  (block and flow forms) map to their 1-based lines; add a fixture with two rules where the
  second rule's `cat` is unknown and assert the line.
- Make `bob bank list -f json` (and the other read envelopes that call `load_config`) carry
  the full config `findings[]` (code, severity, path, line, message, hint) additively when
  the config is invalid, instead of only the first-message `error` string; consider a
  separate `key_path` field on config findings in both `check` and `list` JSON (additive,
  schema_version 1). Keep exit codes unchanged and update docs/bank.md's JSON section.

Found while researching the bank hub's Obsidian setup surface; see the report for context.

task_type_fields.impact:
An invalid `bank:` config disables the whole bank surface (queue card, Category card
categories, imports), yet the plugin-facing `list` JSON names only the first problem with no
line, and rule errors can never be located by line in any output. Any Obsidian surface that
wants to paint located lint for the bank hub (proposed in
research:202611/bank_setup_obsidian_ux__cld.md, slice A) cannot, and terminal users get
`bank.md:` with no line for rule mistakes.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/bank/config.rs:1009 bank_line_map (skips '-' lines); src/native/bank/cli.rs:453 load_config (first diagnostic only)
task_type_fields.repro:
Repro (scratch vault, never the live vault):

```sh
d=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p $d/bank && cat > $d/bank.md <<'YAML'
---
parent: "[[cash]]"
type: "[[area]]"
bank:
  accounts:
    checking:
      label: WF Checking
      kind: chequing
      start: 2026-11-11
  categories:
    coffee: { label: ☕ Coffee, hotkey: c, group: Everyday }
    cafe: { label: ☕ Cafe, hotkey: c }
  rules:
    - match: VENMO
      cat: transfr
---
# Bank
YAML
bob bank check -b $d -f json   # rules finding has "line": null
bob bank list  -b $d -f json   # {"ok":false,"error":"bank.accounts.checking.kind: …"} only, exit 0
```

Observed on bob master 9c2c2404 (2026-11-15):

1. `bob bank check` reports `bank.rules.0.cat: unknown category "transfr"` with `line: null`
   (human output prints `bank.md:` with no line). Root cause: `bank_line_map`
   (`src/native/bank/config.rs:1009`) skips every line whose trimmed text starts with `-`
   (`trimmed.starts_with(['#', '-'])`), so no `bank.rules.<N>` / `bank.rules.<N>.<field>`
   path is ever indexed.
2. `bob bank list -f json` (and every caller of `load_config`, `src/native/bank/cli.rs:453`)
   collapses `ConfigParse::Invalid { diagnostics, .. }` to the first diagnostic's
   `"<key_path>: <message>"` string, so the JSON envelope has no `findings[]`, no line, no
   separate `key_path`, and drops the other errors (3 errors → 1 string). `check -f json`
   also keeps the key path only inside `message`.

issue.creation_reason: An invalid bank: config blacks out the whole bank surface, but rule errors carry no line and the list JSON reports one unlocated message, so neither terminal nor Obsidian lint can point at the problem.

payload.description: Confirm the diagnostics-location bug filed by the cld researcher exists so the consolidated report cites it instead of re-filing

payload.entry: carried by bob-cli-lt.1: added rule sequence locations in block and flow YAML, full located findings on read JSON errors, and key_path in check findings; verified by the phase tests.
